criteria.contract: Local principal and direct retainer explicitly agree scoped, bounded, expiring community administration without transferring ownership, general office or troops
Player and NPC delegates operate only at the actual site within grant budgets; salary reservations, village consent and head absence remain consistent
Delegate reports carry immutable dated local observations through existing physical sealed-message transport; remote principal never sees live accounts or delivery truth
Revocation takes effect on physical arrival, with separate known acknowledgment; report retransmission repeats the same observation without double spending or fresh hidden data
Normal entry and safe UI, v6 legacy bytes, real generation recovery and future equality for travel, report transit, revocation and delegated operation, Game build and headless Node3D
